findings.title: Error timestamps (seconds) compared against rrweb event timestamps (milliseconds)
findings.body: Error timestamps come from nodestore event data, which stores Unix seconds. They are compared to the top-level `timestamp` of each recording event, and rrweb segment events use milliseconds there. Every error timestamp is therefore smaller than every event timestamp. As a result, all error messages are emitted before any breadcrumb, which breaks the intended chronological interleaving in the summary sent to Seer. The tests pass only because they use seconds for both. Normalize the units before comparing, e.g. compare against `event['timestamp'] / 1000`.

findings.title: Error IDs zipped with get_multi values by position
findings.body: `nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids)` returns a dict keyed by node id. The code zips `error_ids` with `events.values()` and assumes the dict iterates in the same order as the input ids. Backends that assemble the result from cache hits and then misses do not preserve that order. In that case error IDs get paired with the wrong event data. Look up each id explicitly, e.g. `events.get(node_id)` for each `(error_id, node_id)` pair.

findings.title: Flagged TableWidgetVisualization renders hard-coded empty data
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, the widget renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns={[]}` and empty `data`/`meta`. It ignores `result.data`, `result.meta` and `fields`. Any org with the flag on will see blank tables on every dashboard table widget. The query results should be passed through instead.

findings.title: Data migration disabled, pointing at a 0921 migration not in this PR
findings.body: Both 0917 and 0920 are turned into no-ops, and their comments point to `0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py` as the correct migration. That file is not added in this change. Unless it already exists, org saved searches will never be converted to views. Add the 0921 migration in this PR or confirm it exists.

findings.title: age/timestamp mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness
findings.body: `validate_timestamp` and `validate_age` check `self.initial_data.get(...)` for truthiness. A report with `age: 0` and a `timestamp` (or `timestamp: 0` and an `age`) passes even though both fields are present. A report with neither field also validates, despite the docstrings saying one must be present. Use `'age' in self.initial_data` and add a `validate()` that requires exactly one of the two.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature check
findings.body: The `preprod_artifact.api.assemble` event is recorded before the feature-flag check. Requests from orgs without the feature, which get a 404, are counted as assemble API usage and inflate the metrics. Move the `analytics.record` call after the feature gate, and possibly after validation.

findings.title: Dead `_handle_regex_match` left in parametrize_w_experiments
findings.body: With the regex experiment type removed, the inner `_handle_regex_match` in `parametrize_w_experiments` is never called. It duplicates the identical helper in `parametrize_w_regex` and should be deleted.
